name: Coinbase
tagline: Crypto exchange and wallet. Loop is usually an online assessment or phone screen, then 2 practical coding rounds, system design and behavioral. Coding is done in a plain editor, often with no starter code, and you're expected to write your own tests.
notes: Most reported: hand-written iterators (range / interleaving over a list of iterators, then follow-ups like peek, filter or laziness), exchange-flavoured state machines (order manager with LIVE/PAUSED/CANCELLED, limit order book with price-time matching), and progressive 'levels' in-memory systems (banking with top spenders and scheduled payments, in-memory DB with TTL, cloud storage). Interviewers care about clean class design, validating input before mutating state, O(1)/O(log n) per operation instead of scanning everything, and writing your own test cases in a blank editor.
